messages:
ellie: Heads-up — seeing 18 micro-chargebacks on acct corp-947 in the last 2h. amounts $0.50–$1.50, most on same merchant descriptor. Looks like card-testing / fraud pattern.

mark: ouch. are they from different card BINs or same card?

payments-bot: New chargebacks created: cb_7f3d9, cb_7f3da, cb_7f3db (18 total). (auto)

samir: quick check: I pulled txn list -> https://billing.redwood.ai/accounts/corp-947/transactions?range=2h — 18 txns id tx_9a... -> all low dollar, settled then chargeback.

lisa: risk-bot flagged new high-frequency chargeback pattern for acct corp-947, risk score 8.2/10

mark: we should freeze billing retries and block new card additions. @payments-team please place a temporary billing hold.

jordan: adding hold now: set account:billing_hold=true. note: this prevents new invoices from auto-charging.

samir: can we gather evidence for the disputes? gateway needs: original auth, AVS/CVV, shipping IPs, device fingerprint, invoice copy.

ellie: yes — needed list for disputes: transaction ids, timestamps, card last4, auth codes, settlement amounts, IPs, device fp, raw gateway webhooks, customer contact history.

mark: samir, can you run the extraction query and drop a CSV to the dispute folder? use this query:

```
SELECT id, created_at, amount, last4, auth_code, ip_address, device_fp
FROM payments.transactions
WHERE account_id='corp-947' AND created_at > now() - interval '3 hours' AND amount < 2.00;
```

samir: running now. will upload to GCP bucket `gs://redwood-disputes/corp-947/1779823456-evidence.csv` once ready.

lisa: legal loop-in: @legal please advise on hold duration & whether to proactively refund disputed txns or let gateway handle.

legal: looking. request full CSV + copy of invoice PDF + any customer support chat snippet. Do not refund yet.

ellie: also flag for treasury: potential chargeback fraud pattern might require notifying acquiring bank. @finance ops

payments-bot: webhook archive created at /api/logs/gateway/2026-03-19/1779823456.zip

mark: ok priority actions checklist:
- [x] put billing hold
- [ ] export transactions CSV (samir)
- [ ] collect gateway auth logs (samir)
- [ ] attach invoice PDFs (ops)
- [ ] legal review (legal)
- [ ] notify acquirer if pattern confirmed (finance)

samir: uploaded CSV to bucket and posted link: https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-disputes/corp-947/1779823456-evidence.csv

ellie: thanks. I'll prepare dispute packages and open vendor tickets with gateway (Stripe/Adyen whichever) with cb refs.

jordan: FYI — I blocked `corp-947` from adding new cards + disabled tokenization on the account.

lisa: follow-up: any sign of internal test from product? prod-engineers please confirm no internal scripts charged those cards.

eng-dev: checked — no tests. all traffic attributed to realtime API.

ellie: final note — if gateway pushes back we may need to escalate to ops director. will update thread with outcome. :memo:
